name: Leave at the disconnect: the seat ends while the engine still holds the row
replace:
Disconnect == /\ row = "live" /\ row' = "held" /\ seat' = "away"
              /\ heard' = IF heard = "joined" THEN "away" ELSE heard
              /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, hero, listed, joins, leaves>>

Disconnect == /\ row = "live" /\ row' = "held" /\ seat' = "none" /\ heard' = "none"
              /\ leaves' = IF heard = "none" THEN leaves ELSE leaves + 1
              /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, hero, listed, joins>>

name: Strays ignores away seats: it lays down a held hero
A return is a new join: the mod hears a second join without a leave
replace: /\ joins' = IF heard = "none" THEN joins + 1 ELSE joins
